transport_contract.credentials_source: WordPress wp-config constants or WordPress options; credentials are not stored in this contract.

hard_rules: Subject-matter logic defines genuinely distinct article intents and content capacity.
DataForSEO validates SEO evidence and may collapse duplicate subject-defined intents via exact core_keyword/synonym evidence.
Missing exact DataForSEO longtail rows do not erase fachlich distinct article intents; only their SEO metrics remain pending.
Raw keyword_ideas/keyword_suggestions rows never create additional article intents.
DataForSEO may not decide world, parent, leaf family, portal role, CORE promotion or deletion.
A lowest-level category is evaluated separately; hobby-wide totals are insufficient.

request_plan.rationale: KISS: subject logic defines capacity; one overview cross-check enriches/deduplicates. Automatic depth research is not part of the normal path.

postprocess: Count subject-defined genuinely distinct article intents per lowest-level category.
Collapse exact synonyms/duplicates when real core_keyword/synonym evidence proves equivalence.
Do not remove a fachlich distinct article intent merely because DataForSEO omitted an exact longtail row.
Do not create article intents from provider raw rows.
Apply concept thresholds: under 4 combine/no leaf; 4 borderline; 5-12 ideal; 13-14 above ideal without automatic split; from about 15 review a real split.
For thin valid hobbies, test aggregation without merging canonical hobby identities.
followup_reason: Historical depth data is retained as evidence history, but automatic keyword-ideas depth research is not needed for content-capacity counting under rules 1.4.
